category: Application Library examples: LiveLink for MATLAB
description: Ready-made, documented example simulations installed with the LiveLink for MATLAB. Each lists its physics interfaces, couplings and study steps; solve one with comsol_run_example or adapt its Java build script.

tools.name: Convective Heat Transfer with Pseudoperiodicity [LiveLink for MATLAB example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the LiveLink for MATLAB (Tutorials): Convective Heat Transfer with Pseudoperiodicity. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.
tools.usage: MCP: comsol_run_example("LiveLink_for_MATLAB/Tutorials/pseudoperiodicity_llmatlab") to solve it, comsol_example_info("pseudoperiodicity_llmatlab", include_java=true) for its build script. COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > LiveLink for MATLAB > Tutorials > pseudoperiodicity llmatlab
tools.notes: Library path LiveLink_for_MATLAB/Tutorials/pseudoperiodicity_llmatlab; model file 1.5 MB. Requires the module licence to open and solve.
